cues: During an indoor spin class, participants pedal steadily while an instructor cues short bursts of higher resistance.
A commuter follows a protected lane downtown, slowing where construction crews redirect traffic around a blocked intersection.
Before a gran fondo, organizers place refreshment tables at intervals along the climbing route.
A coach reviews cadence data after training, adjusting the next session to build endurance for long climbs.
At a neighborhood meeting, residents request a protected route linking the school, library, and train station.
An urban planner tests a newly painted corridor during morning traffic, noting where parked cars obstruct visibility.
